scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rules-test "npx vitest run functions/src/rules.test.ts"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run functions:typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run functions:test && npm run build && npm run functions:build && npm run rules:check && npm run v3:check && npm run secrets:check && npm run seo:check && npm run check:prod
scripts.ci: npm run ci:install && npm run verify && npm run audit
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --project airpalme-app
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting --project airpalme-app
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run functions:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions --project airpalme-app
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:ios:airpal: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -xcconfig ios/App/AirPal.xcconfig archive -archivePath build/ios/AirPal.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/ios/AirPal.xcarchive -exportPath build/ios/export-airpal -exportOptionsPlist ios/App/ExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.build:ios:pass: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -xcconfig ios/App/Pass.xcconfig archive -archivePath build/ios/AirPalPass.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/ios/AirPalPass.xcarchive -exportPath build/ios/export-pass -exportOptionsPlist ios/App/ExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:ios:airpal && npm run build:ios:pass
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
